summary: Snowy Summit, a 1930s tower on the Clearwater National Forest, was abandoned in the 1950s; the FFLA lists the tower as gone.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site today.

events.note: Firelookout.com dates the tower to the 1930s.
The 1950s abandonment appears in firelookout.com, the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts.

evidence.supports: Tower dated to the 1930s and abandoned in the 1950s
Forest Service list gives abandonment in the 1950s
Forest Service list gives elevation 5,904 feet
Elevation 5,904 feet and Clearwater National Forest

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict is unresolved. The FFLA list gives 46.44208, -115.59187 (the value in our record). The Idaho Fire Lookouts record value, 46.42231, -115.59164, is about 2.2 km south, and the Idaho page text we read has no coordinates to check it against. Map check needed before any pin is published. Dates and elevation agree across firelookout.com, the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Forest Service list places it at Sec33 T36N R7E. FFLA Tower Gone gives no removal date. No source describes the site today. Record county is Idaho; sources say Idaho County. No new photos added.
